content: Weekly synergy dashboard fields: total value (planned vs realized run-rate), forecast run-rate next quarter, one-time integration costs, top-5 levers by value, top risks/dependencies, decisions needed this week. Synergy tracker row schema: type, workstream, initiative, owner, baseline, planned run-rate, realized run-rate, forecast run-rate, start date, target date, status, dependencies, risks, proof source, notes. Board-level export should strip operational noise -> show net benefit, cost-to-achieve, confidence delta only, with bar (cumulative benefit), waterfall (period variance), heat-map (risk) chart types. PMI software vendors position a single IMO workspace that rolls RAID/tasks/synergies into one CFO-grade export.
